Privacy First · Zero Telemetry

Privacy Policy

The Cosmic Mythology AR Explorer is engineered as a zero-tracking, client-side only static application.

1. Geolocation & Horizon Computing

Summary: Your location coordinates are processed strictly inside your device's browser and are never transmitted to any remote server or stored.

When you permit location access in your browser:

  • The application reads your latitude and longitude solely to calculate your local sidereal time (LST) and orient the celestial sphere and planisphere to match the actual night sky visible above your horizon.
  • No location coordinates, IP addresses, or device identifiers are sent over the network. The app functions completely without internet after initial page load.
  • If you deny location permission, the application falls back gracefully to a default observer latitude (45°N) with zero degradation of any constellation, myth, or scientific feature.

2. On-Device Progress Storage & Optional Cloud Synchronization

Summary: Gameplay state, cards, stars, and achievements are stored first on your local device. Cloud synchronization is entirely optional and never blocks gameplay.
  • Local-First Storage: By default, all constellation trail progression, earned stars, unlocked collectible cards, daily streak, lives, and audio playback settings are persisted directly in standard browser localStorage under the key cosmic_save_v2. No account or network connection is required to play offline.
  • Optional Cloud Sync (Supabase): When configured with a backend, stargazers may optionally sign in using email magic links or OAuth providers (Google, GitHub) to mirror progress across multiple devices. Cloud data is protected by Row Level Security (RLS) in PostgreSQL, ensuring only your authenticated account can read or write your progress row.
  • Progress Merging: When signing in on multiple devices, progress merges safely (maximum for counters, union for unlocked cards and completed quests) so no achievements are ever lost.
  • Data Control: We never sell or track your gameplay. You can reset or erase your stored progress at any time by clicking "Reset Saved Progress" in the Mission Settings dialog or by clearing site cookies and storage in your browser preferences.

3. Third-Party Requests, Self-Hosting & Server Logs

  • 100% Self-Hosted Assets (Zero Third-Party CDNs): All library scripts (Three.js pinned to release r128) and all typography (Cormorant Garamond and Space Grotesk) are self-hosted directly on the origin server under /vendor/ and /assets/fonts/. External calls to Google Fonts and Cloudflare CDN have been completely removed.
  • Web Speech API & Cloud Voices: In-browser audio story narration uses the standard W3C Web Speech API. While speech is processed on-device whenever native offline voices are available, certain operating systems (such as iOS, Android, or ChromeOS) may route speech requests through vendor cloud text-to-speech services if the user's operating system is configured to use cloud-backed voices.
  • Hosting Server Logs: Standard static hosting platforms (such as Netlify, Vercel, or Cloudflare Pages) automatically log incoming HTTP request metadata (IP address, user agent, requested file, and timestamp) for network routing, security, and caching. The Cosmic Explorer application operates zero databases, sets zero cookies, and runs no analytics software to process or retain these logs.
  • External Outbound Links: Astronomical news cards and citation audits contain direct links to external observatories and academic institutions (NASA, ESA, ESO, Perseus, Sacred Texts). Clicking those external links connects you directly to those third-party domains under their respective privacy policies.
